claims.claim: The main Leyndell progression lists Avenue Balcony before West Capital Rampart; the dragon-wing climb from Avenue Balcony reaches the West Capital Rampart grace.
West Capital Rampart branches upward through the root to the Royal Capital Godfrey gate and downward through the gargoyle/stable route to Fortified Manor, First Floor.
Lower Capital Church is an explicit lower-city branch reached from the Avenue Balcony side through the underpass/roof/drop route, not a same-floor alias of Avenue Balcony.

The Fortified Manor lower-courtyard elevator reaches Divine Bridge, and the bridge-side waygate leads to the Isolated Divine Tower; this is a vertical/teleport plane transition rather than a walkable Caelid road.

After Morgott, the Elden Throne route exits through the capital elevator to Forbidden Lands; the normal road reaches Grand Lift of Rold, while the separate bridge branch triggers the Fell Twins before the East Altus Divine Tower.

notes: The snapshot records route claims and source URLs only; it does not copy game archives, original XYZ coordinates, or local save state.
Conditions are modeled as selectable world/quest state and are not claims about the current player save.
